digest.component_or_area: bridge runner orchestration and provider CI wrappers
propositions: Bridge orchestration logic must be extracted into a runner-neutral Python core package exposable through library, CLI, and MCP interfaces from pip, Homebrew, and uvx/MCP Registry install paths.

The runner accepts five profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to canonical rebar commands while preserving legacy MODE environment variable and direct-caller result behavior.

Provider CI wrappers (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) delegate to installed rebar bridge run command and are schema-validated with pinned ShellCheck; GitLab schema includes immutable upstream revision and SHA-256 provenance.
Successful non-paused runs invoke strict ticket-store delivery with run id and bot identity; delivery failure returns exit code 1; malformed pause markers do not silently skip delivery.

Legacy benign reconcile results (3/4/75) are preserved for direct callers but translated to canonical 0 by the new provider runner; shallow repositories return invalid invocation before reconciliation.
